name: Olivia R.
quote: Jonathan is a fantastic trainer. He is professional and has an incredible depth of knowledge about how the body works, particularly for me as I recovered from an injury. He is welcoming and kind, and knows how to push you to be your best without going too far. I would recommend him to anyone looking for a fun, relentlessly positive trainer or coach.

name: Haley
quote: Jonathan is a fantastic coach and instructor. He creates a space full of joy and is incredibly welcoming. He meets people where they're at — whether they're experienced lifters or have never used a barbell in their lives. He's helped me greatly progress with my lifting in such a supportive manner.

name: Ting
context: Group classes — BeastBox Bootcamp, Bouldering Project
quote: I'm super new to the BeastBox Bootcamp class at the Bouldering Project in Somerville but I can already tell I'll be coming back every Wednesday. I love how it is set up as a group class while being self-paced. I can go at my own rhythm, but still feel motivated by everyone around me. It's a really nice balance between a chill vibe and pushing yourself hard. Everyone in the class is incredibly kind, which makes a big difference when I'm new and figuring out how to set up. Jonathan is amazing. He is so attentive, patient, and helpful with correcting my form. And I love his playlist too!

name: Nicoletta DeTorres
quote: I had such a great experience working with Jonathan and would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a trainer. He really took the time to understand my goals and created workouts that felt truly tailored to me. As someone who doesn't go to the gym often and has a lot of gym anxiety, I really appreciated how patient and encouraging he was — he made me feel comfortable and more confident right away. He's a great teacher and was always willing to walk me through movements, and he consistently checked in and adjusted my workouts as I progressed. Jonathan creates such a positive, supportive, and completely judgment-free environment, which made it easy to stay motivated and actually look forward to going. I'm really glad I worked with Jonathan and would absolutely work with him again.

name: Anonymous
quote: Jonathan is the best group fitness instructor I have ever worked with. My husband and I have been attending his classes over the past year, and they have made such a positive impact on our fitness. The classes are structured clearly and efficiently. All of the exercises are approachable and engaging for people coming from any fitness background. Most instructors can lead a group through a workout, but where Jonathan truly shines is in his ability to build community and connection with each participant. His classes are always upbeat and he balances tending to the group with providing individualized attention.

name: Lisa Mirabile
quote: I've worked with Jon for over 2 years, and he's been fantastic! He is a careful observer who offers steady, helpful suggestions to improve my form, and positive feedback when it's good (or has gotten better). He always has a clear answer for my many questions about the purpose or technique of a particular exercise, and is quick to find appropriate workarounds or changes if I mention even a minor limitation or injury. And on top of all that, he's reliably cheerful in a calm and steady way and always game for a conversation about just about anything, if that's what you're up for. He's a gem.

name: Jonathan Merin
quote: I had never done any real weight training before when I started 18 months ago. I knew a drill sergeant or a cheerleader weren't for me. I wanted somebody who was more of a friend, but a friend with expertise. Jonathan has been all of that and more. For me, I wanted to make sure that what I was doing was safe, was productive, and was effective. Not only has he designed multiple routines for me over our time together, but he has been encouraging without being pushy or authoritarian. He's never made me feel bad if I was tired but he has pushed me to do as much as I can and encouraged me even when I didn't feel like I was succeeding. He's been a sounding board on multiple health issues and discussions and I've enjoyed getting to know him a little bit in the process. I highly recommend him as a personal trainer and I will miss him greatly as he is off to his next adventure.

name: Anonymous
quote: Jonathan is a great trainer. He listens carefully to my stated goals and develops personalized plans to help me work toward these goals. Jonathan creates a comfortable environment in which to try new things and is also responsive to any concerns I have and adjusts things as needed. He is a caring person and fun to train with, providing me with lots of information about training and also providing the necessary distractions to complete challenging sessions. I will miss working with him!

name: Laurie N.
quote: I've been training with Jonathan for over a year, and I can't recommend him highly enough! He's smart, fun, interesting, and knows how to push me beyond what I think I can do, which has helped me get stronger and even hit a couple of PRs along the way. Jonathan makes workouts challenging without making them miserable. He knows when to push, when to encourage, and how to keep things interesting. There's always good conversation which takes my mind off the workout. I'm stronger and more confident than I was when I started, and I genuinely look forward to our sessions. If you're looking for a trainer who's knowledgeable, motivating, fun to be around, and possibly knows more about bike racing than any human reasonably should, Jonathan is your guy!

name: David T. Golden MD
quote: Jon is a great trainer. He is knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and professional. He has encouraged me to expand my range of training activities and pushed for some of my personal bests! I've enjoyed working with him.
